goal: Connect several vehicles to one GCS at the same time and send commands only to the selected one
users: One GCS operator monitoring and controlling up to 4 vehicles at once

in: routing commands to the selected vehicle
out: swarm flight (one command to many vehicles)

requirements.text: Connect and keep up to 4 vehicles connected at once

acceptance.text: With 4 SITL vehicles connected for 10 minutes, every vehicle's heartbeat arrives at most 1 s apart

requirements.text: Commands go only to the currently selected vehicle

acceptance.text: With vehicle B selected, every command sent has target_system B, and A/C/D receive none

requirements.text: Per-vehicle telemetry and state never mix

acceptance.text: While receiving telemetry from 4 vehicles, each vehicle panel shows only values from its own system_id

requirements.text: A link failure on one vehicle does not affect control of the others

acceptance.text: While vehicle A's link is cut, command latency for vehicle B stays within the single-vehicle baseline +50 ms

requirements.text: The existing single-vehicle workflow keeps working unchanged

acceptance.text: All existing single-vehicle regression tests pass

requirements.text: A deselected vehicle keeps executing its current mission

acceptance.text: Switching selection from A (in an AUTO mission) to B does not change A's mode or waypoint progress

decisions.question: Does a deselected vehicle keep its mission?
decisions.answer: Yes, it keeps the mission (no automatic LOITER)

decisions.question: Changing the target while a command is in flight
decisions.answer: Switch only after the pending command's ACK (or a 3 s timeout)

open_questions.text: Should a deselected vehicle keep its mission, or switch to LOITER?
UI message when a 5th vehicle tries to connect
open_questions.proposed_default: Toast: 'Up to 4 vehicles can be connected'

assumptions.text: Each vehicle has a unique system_id (duplicates are refused)
